# Script Toolbox

> Configurable script toolbox and UI builder for Maya, Nuke, and Houdini.

This file is the LLM-oriented entry point for Script Toolbox documentation. Development work is integrated in the dev branch. The current development configuration contract is schema 21.

For requests to create a Script Toolbox template, preset, reusable UI block, or importable configuration, read the authoring specification first.

## LLM authoring

- [Template / preset authoring specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/developer/llm-template-authoring.md): canonical machine-oriented guide for generating preset definitions, item subtrees, bindings, and complete configuration documents.
- [Current architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): schema, item registry, layout and section semantics, runtime contracts.
- [Item guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/guide/items.md): user-facing overview of built-in item types.
- [Scripting guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/guide/scripting.md): bindings, script languages, names and references.

## Hosts

- [Nuke](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/NUKE.md)
- [Houdini](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/docs/HOUDINI.md)

## Source-of-truth code

- [Config version](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/scripts/script_toolbox/constants.py)
- [Universal item model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/scripts/script_toolbox/model/items.py)
- [Built-in item definitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/scripts/script_toolbox/model/item_builtins.py)
- [Preset registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/scripts/script_toolbox/core/presets.py)
- [Binding contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RomanKrike/script-toolbox/dev/scripts/script_toolbox/model/bindings.py)

If the CONFIG_VERSION in source differs from the version stated in the authoring specification, treat the source as newer and do not invent a migration.
